entity_name: North Lebanon Water Establishment (مؤسسة مياه لبنان الشمالي)

facts.value: North Lebanon Water Establishment. Manages potable water supply, customer complaints, service requests, billing/payment, and branch follow-up for North Lebanon and Akkar runtime scope. Complaint domains encoded for routing: water_outage, dirty_water, pipe_leak_public, water_pressure_low, meter_billing_dispute, new_water_connection, water_contamination, sewage_services, service_request.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: electricity; road_damage; private_plumbing; private_wells; storm_drain_without_sewer_evidence; LRA_irrigation_assets; private_plumbing_private_well_or_tanker_vendor_dispute; Route instead to PRIVATE_PROPERTY_OR_VENDOR_OR_HITL when Complaint concerns private source/vendor rather than public NLWE network.; local_storm_drain_or_road_flooding; Route instead to MUN_OR_MPWT_BY_ROAD_CLASS when No evidence of sewerage/wastewater network ownership.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.
